sketches.mechanism: Move semantics transfer ownership to the called function, and the compiler rejects any later use of the moved value.
sketches.resonance: What has been given away remains named but is no longer available to the one who gave it.

sketches.mechanism: An automatic object’s lifetime ends when its block returns, so dereferencing a pointer to it afterward has undefined behavior.
sketches.resonance: A surviving address is not the same as a surviving presence.

sketches.mechanism: Variables are single-assignment and `=` is pattern matching, so binding the same variable to a different value fails with `badmatch`.
sketches.resonance: A vow can be matched again only if nothing has changed.
